source_summary: Tall Chinese shanshui landscape with monumental ink-wash mountains, layered hills, mist gaps, small roofed village/pavilion groups, dense tree groves, ravines, rocks, and foreground streams. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the towering upper-left mountain group: multiple steep rounded peaks rising from mist, with the highest dark-textured summit near the upper center-left and paler flanking ridges at the far left.
must_preserve: long vertical hemp-fiber contour strokes on the slopes
dark clustered ink dots along crest lines and summit vegetation
soft grey wash transitions fading into mist at the lower slopes
irregular rounded peak silhouettes
fine internal ridgeline linework without including nearby inscription areas

motifs.name: central_twin_cliffs_waterfall
motifs.description: Isolate the central high cliff formation with two rounded ink-textured rock faces and the narrow pale vertical waterfall or ravine descending between the right cliffs.
must_preserve: dense black moss dots on cliff rims
curving layered rock-striation lines
pale unpainted waterfall channel with soft misty edges
dark wooded saddle between rock faces
subtle warm-brown and grey wash on the cliff bodies

motifs.name: left_layered_hillside
motifs.description: Isolate the broad mid-left hillside made of horizontal, wave-like ridges and forested bands descending toward the central valley.
must_preserve: stacked parallel ridge contours
short vertical tree strokes in rows along the slopes
dark stippled vegetation bands
soft wash gradients between hill layers
left-edge mist fade and lower path-like pale openings

motifs.name: central_hidden_roof_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the small hidden village or pavilion roofs nestled in the central valley among steep hills and dense trees.
must_preserve: rectangular tiled roof geometry with fine parallel roof lines
tiny wall and eave outlines
surrounding slender trunks and dense leaf-dot foliage
enclosing rocky slopes with textured contour strokes
subtle ochre wash accents on earth and roof areas

motifs.name: midright_hillside_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right pavilion compound set on a sloping hillside, partly enclosed by trees and rocks above the lower valley.
must_preserve: small roofed structures with angular eaves
faint rail or wall lines within the compound
surrounding pine and deciduous tree silhouettes
rocky hillside contour strokes wrapping around the buildings
light mineral blue-green and ochre accents in vegetation and ground

motifs.name: foreground_left_cottage_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left cottage and grove: a small simple house at the foot of rocks, surrounded by bare-branched trees, shrubs, and a tall pine-like tree.
must_preserve: thin architectural wall and roof lines of the cottage
bare twig-like branch network in front of and around the house
dark pine needle clusters and trunk texture
rounded foreground rocks with fine contour hatching
dense shrub dots and light color washes near the base

motifs.name: foreground_right_riverside_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right waterside pavilion or hall with open bays, set beside trees and a stream at the foot of a tall dark tree stand.
must_preserve: long horizontal roof with clear eaves and support posts
open interior bay linework and tiny seated-figure-like interior marks if visible
nearby tall vertical tree trunks and dark foliage mass
stream-edge contour lines and bank textures
pale wash around the water and soft ochre-blue color accents

motifs.name: foreground_winding_stream_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the central foreground ravine and stream course with clustered rocks, low shrubs, leafless trees, and small cascades winding upward into the valley.
must_preserve: meandering pale water channels with ink ripple lines
rounded boulders with layered contour hatching
dense shrub clusters made of repeated leaf dots
bare tree trunks and branching networks
small cascade strokes and misty water edges between rocks

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
